text: The project uses SQLite as its durable local database and single source of truth.
SQLite runs in WAL mode with synchronous set to NORMAL and a five second busy timeout.
Back up the SQLite file by copying it after a WAL checkpoint, never while a write transaction is open.
A hosted Postgres backend was evaluated and rejected because it breaks offline-first operation.
Old snapshots stored mutable state in large JSON files and caused quadratic disk growth.
A comparison of LMDB against SQLite found comparable read latency but much worse tooling for LMDB.
Each scope owns a directory holding the event journal, the SQLite projection, and a config file.
A scope larger than two gigabytes on disk triggers a warning during status reporting.
OAuth token refresh fails when two login requests rotate the same refresh token concurrently.
The OAuth client requests only the read scopes it needs and never asks for offline access by default.
Authentication moved from a custom password store to an external OAuth provider.
Access tokens expire after fifteen minutes and refresh tokens after thirty days.
Revoking a session deletes the whole refresh token family so replayed tokens are rejected.
Login attempts are limited to ten per minute per source address.
Browser sessions use secure HTTP-only cookies with same-site protection.
State-changing requests carry a double-submit token that is verified against the session.
Same-site lax cookies still travel on top-level navigations, so state-changing routes need their own check.
The legacy password table stored salted hashes and was dropped after the provider migration.
Never push directly to protected branches; changes reach develop through a pull request.
Every pull request needs one approving review before it can merge.
Release tags follow semantic versioning and are cut from develop after the checks pass.
A hotfix branches from the release tag and merges back into both develop and the release line.
The changelog is generated from commit subjects and edited by hand before a release.
Feature branches are squashed on merge so develop keeps one commit per change.
Run npm run check, npm test, and npm pack --dry-run before review.
Integration tests spawn the real binary and are kept out of the default unit run.
A bug fix lands with a regression test that fails without the fix.
A test that fails intermittently is quarantined the same day and either repaired or deleted.
Shared fixtures live beside the suites and are never generated at run time.
Continuous integration runs on the current long-term-support runtime only.
Capture corrections, decisions, verified failures, and reusable evidence; do not memorize routine file reads.
Credentials, tokens, and private keys are never written into durable knowledge.
A claim without supporting evidence is stored as a candidate and needs review before it is trusted.
Marking an item helpful or wrong adjusts how strongly it is ranked in later turns.
Near-duplicate statements are consolidated so the same knowledge is not stored twice.
Facts carry valid-at and invalid-at timestamps so historical answers do not overwrite current truth.
A replacement statement marks the previous one superseded and links the two together.
A query may ask what was believed at an earlier moment and gets the answer as it stood then.
An item that has been contradicted stops being returned even before it is collected.
Independent Pi sessions coordinate through a local append-only team mailbox journal.
No network broker or daemon is required for two agents on one machine to exchange work.
Sending to the whole team enqueues one copy of the message for each recipient.
A job that produces no output for its timeout window is fenced and reported as stalled.
Each participant writes only its own stream, so no two writers ever contend for one file.
Semantic retrieval uses an offline multilingual sentence encoder and a SQLite vector index.
Retrieval must keep working with the network unplugged, so no hosted inference is on the critical path.
Unit-normalized vectors are scalar-quantized to eight bits, cutting index size fourfold.
If the encoder is unavailable the lexical leg still answers and the dense leg is filled in later.
Changing the encoder creates a new collection; the old one is dropped once nothing points at it.
The encoder emits three hundred eighty-four dimensions per passage.
Retrieved context is bounded by bytes, diversified by source, and explicitly reports omitted candidates.
The calling agent reranks and verifies candidates; the retriever never decides what is true.
Highly similar passages are collapsed so one loud source cannot fill the whole window.
When nothing clears the bar the retriever returns nothing and says why instead of guessing.
Garbage collection first removes rebuildable embeddings, obsolete chunks, and unreferenced projections while preserving supported evidence.
Collection never touches the append-only log, only the derived tables it can rebuild.
Cleanup is an explicit operator action, not a background timer.
Space is returned to the filesystem incrementally rather than in one long pause.
The interface uses high contrast typography and avoids decorative gradients.
Panels stay dense with small margins; whitespace is not padded out for its own sake.
Both light and dark presentations must be legible without changing the layout.
Motion is limited to state changes the reader would otherwise miss.
A stale cache survived file replacement because it was keyed only by modification time instead of inode, size, and timestamp.
The cache is warmed on first access and never pre-populated at start up.
The in-process cache holds at most sixty-four entries and evicts the oldest.
Caching a missing lookup without a expiry made a later successful write invisible for the rest of the run.
Database schema migrations are additive, idempotent, and rebuild disposable indexes from the event journal.
A file written by a newer version than the running code is refused rather than opened.
No migration drops a column or renames one in place; a new column is added instead.
Only one reconstruction may run at a time for a scope, guarded by an exclusive lock file.
Recognizable credential shapes are masked before any text is written to disk.
Masking is pattern based and cannot be relied on to catch every possible shape.
The fingerprint of an excerpt is computed after masking so the original never leaks through the digest.
The retrieval tools own output is never captured as support for a later claim.
Support is labelled as observed by the host, declared by a person, or reported by an agent.
A single supporting excerpt is truncated at eight kilobytes.
Events are appended and never edited; every derived table can be thrown away and rebuilt.
Each entry carries the fingerprint of the one before it, so a silent edit breaks the chain.
Entries are grouped into one file per writer per calendar day in coordinated universal time.
A single entry larger than sixty-four kilobytes is rejected at write time.
Every entry is flushed to stable storage before the call returns, trading throughput for durability.
A working directory maps to a stable identifier that survives moving the checkout.
One project never reads another project's knowledge unless it is explicitly shared.
A shared area holds knowledge that applies everywhere, such as tool preferences.
Storage directories are created readable only by their owner.
Diagnostics are written at debug level and suppressed unless explicitly enabled.
Log lines never contain user content, only identifiers and counts.
An error says what was expected, what happened, and what to do next.
A caught exception is either handled or rethrown, never silently discarded.
Environment variables win over the on-disk configuration file.
Api credentials are read only from the environment and never persisted alongside settings.
A fresh install works with no configuration at all.
Ingestion is dominated by flushing each entry to stable storage, not by encoding text.
Substring matching over every stored passage made query latency grow in step with corpus size.
Passages are encoded sixty-four at a time rather than one by one.
Automatic recall added to a turn must stay under a small fraction of the prompt.
Values are not reassigned; new values are derived instead of mutated in place.
Untyped escape hatches are not allowed in checked source.
Modules are imported with explicit file extensions and no default exports.
The minimum supported runtime is the current long-term-support release.
The design document explains boundaries and deliberately records what the system cannot do.
The readme carries copy-pasteable commands rather than prose descriptions of them.
A measurement is reported with the conditions that produced it or not reported at all.
A new runtime dependency needs a reason that outweighs its transitive surface.
Advisories affecting shipped packages are reviewed before publishing.
Runtime dependency versions are pinned exactly; development ones may float.
Only the entry point, sources, docs, and licence are published; tests and scripts stay out.
Sub-paths are exported for the vector, contract, and source layers.
Passages target twelve hundred characters with a hundred sixty character overlap.
Text is split on blank lines first and only then hard-split when a block is too long.
Exact, lexical, and dense candidate lists are combined by reciprocal rank rather than raw scores.
Host observations outrank agent reports when everything else is equal.
Two statements that conflict are ordered by which one was recorded later.
